idea-plugin.name: KMP Dependency Hub
idea-plugin.description: Browse curated Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform and Android libraries and add several at once to any module. Each library is placed in the right source sets (commonMain, androidMain, iosMain, ...), with version catalog entries, KSP configurations and Gradle plugins, and you see a diff before anything is written. The Doctor flags commonMain dependencies that don't support your targets.

action.description: Check KMP dependencies for platform and version problems
